decontamination_notes: cii-v2 EPIC (candidate #1 under the frontier admission gate). Composes TWO merged networkx PRs into one task: #8734 'Fix k_components losing or truncating k-components' (merged 2026-07-07) and its follow-up #8753 'Prune nested components in k_components reconstruction' (merged 2026-07-24) — both post-June-2026; upstream_merged records the later PR. Three interacting root causes in the exact Moody-White algorithm (networkx/algorithms/connectivity/kcomponents.py): (1) partition generation removed the union of all cutsets in a single pass and filtered nodes of degree <= k, silently dropping cutset nodes whose neighbors all lie in other cutsets and losing k-components; (2) reconstruction skipped propagating a (k+1)-level component that spans several k-level candidates without being a subset of any, replacing a genuine k-component by fragments; (3) a single consolidate pass can emit a component nested inside another, i.e. a non-maximal 'component'. Base chosen as the parent of #8734's merge commit; verified only these two PRs touched kcomponents.py in the window; gold is the two-PR diff of that one file. Failures at base are SILENT (output satisfies local invariants but is wrong), so the task cannot be solved by self-checking simple contracts. Guards pin the petersen decomposition, five verified non-divergent G(n,p) decompositions (base==gold), an output contract (no nesting, induced connectivity), directed-input rejection, and the untouched approximation module.
